description: Verify that a DHCPNAK received in RENEWING restarts the configuration process (RFC 2131 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
A NAK in RENEWING means the server rejects the renewal — the binding is gone. The client must abandon ciaddr and return to INIT, eventually emitting a fresh DISCOVER.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND → T1 → RENEWING → renew DHCPREQUEST.
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPNAK.
3. DUT returns to INIT and eventually emits DHCPDISCOVER #2   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Full chain DISCOVER#1 → REQUEST#1 → renewing REQUEST → DISCOVER#2 observed.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing → corresponding Fail_no_* verdict.

verdicts.Pass: DUT restarted with DISCOVER #2 after NAK in RENEWING — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_second_discover: No DUT second DISCOVER after returning to INIT
